questions.prompt: How are ordinary objects compared with ===?
options: By comparing every nested property automatically.
By comparing the order in which keys were declared.
All empty object literals compare equal.
By reference identity, not by recursively comparing their properties.
questions.explanation: Two separately created object literals are different objects even if their properties look identical.
